The first release of Tessera: generative posters for Mac and Windows. Pick a design, turn the knobs until you like it, add a title and export a print-ready PNG.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon) | `Tessera-macos-arm64.zip` – unzip and move `Tessera.app` to *Applications* |
| **Windows** (64-bit) | `Tessera-windows-x64.zip` – unzip and start `Tessera.exe`, no install needed |

The Mac app is only signed locally, so on first launch macOS blocks it: open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click **Open Anyway**. Windows SmartScreen may warn too – *More info → Run anyway*.

## What's in it

- **Three designs:** Flow (thousands of lines following a Perlin-noise current), Ridges (stacked mountain lines) and Bauhaus (a grid of tiles with circles, rings, triangles and stripes) – each with its own knobs
- **Nine palettes:** Bauhaus, Ink, Night, Riso, Sunset, Ocean, Forest, Neon, Pastel
- **Surprise me** (<kbd>Space</kbd>) rolls a new seed, <kbd>←</kbd> / <kbd>→</kbd> step through seeds, *Shuffle* tries random parameters
- **Paper:** A5 to A2, square or 4:5, portrait or landscape, white, cream or black paper
- **Layouts:** full page, frame or circle
- **Text:** title and subtitle with typeface, size, weight, letter spacing, capitals and alignment
- **Export PNG** (<kbd>⌘E</kbd>) at 300, 150 or 72 dpi – the resolution is stored in the file, so an A4 export prints at exactly A4
- The same seed and settings always give the same poster; settings are remembered between launches

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksums of both downloads.
